text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 19.0 to 19.8 s. The white car sits stopped at the center of the flooded street with water over its wheels to the lower doors. At 19.6 s and 19.8 s small amber lamps glow at the front and rear corners of the car. Street, houses and sidewalk hold. Caption unchanged.
